meta_description: LightHaus Interiors in Bristol specialises in interior and exterior painting and decorating. Professional finishes, free quotes, and attention to detail.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured — Free Quotes Within 24 Hours
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert decoration. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver flawless finishes every time.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: Whether it's a bedroom refresh or a full commercial repaint, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Full room repaints using premium paints and professional techniques. We move furniture, protect floors, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create visual impact with expert feature wall installation. Bold colours, wallpaper, or textured finishes that transform any space.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for your home's façade, soffits, and fascias. We use trade-grade materials built to last in Bristol's climate.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Precise wallpaper installation on any surface, from traditional paste to modern vinyl. Pattern matching and seamless finishes guaranteed.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Finishing
services.desc: Expert painting of doors, skirting boards, architrave, and windows. We prep, prime, and apply multiple coats for a lasting, professional look.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality repainting with minimal disruption to your business. We schedule around your operating hours.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own. That's how we've built our reputation.
about_para_1: LightHaus Interiors was founded in 2012 by a team of painters frustrated with the inconsistency and poor communication they saw in the Bristol decorating market. Over the past twelve years, we've grown from a two-person outfit to a trusted local name, completing over 500 projects across Southville, Bedminster, Stokes Croft, and beyond. We're fully insured and always meticulous about preparation and detail.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, finish when we say we will, and stand behind our work. We invest in quality materials and don't cut corners on prep—that's why our finishes last. Most of our business comes from word-of-mouth and repeat clients who've seen the difference a proper paint job makes to their home.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About LightHaus Interiors

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Mark and his team completely transformed our lounge. They were tidy, professional, and finished a day early. The paint work is flawless. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had them repaint our kitchen and hallway. Free quote was spot-on with no hidden costs. They moved everything, protected the floors, and did a really thorough job. Very happy with the results.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed my bedroom done quickly before a house viewing. They squeezed us in and delivered in two days. Looks like a show home now. Best money I've spent on the house. Will use them again.
reviews.author: James T.
